test_title: Delhi Police Constable (Executive) 2023 - Reasoning (Held on: 30 Nov, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Which figure should replace the question mark (?) if the following series were to be continued?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a2d70a3d76f16acc17dace80e1a6b3e9094c13f4696fae7871979fc0206e4c4.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

1) First box series →

The elements at the corners shift diagonally.

The center element is replaced by a new element.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1aa2bd35acde483415d77ce441b2c2a672ba07b81f688dd720f0eea476273879.png] 

2) Second box series →

The elements at the corners shift anticlockwise subsequently.

The center element is replaced by a new element.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d6b4e868b22ce18ab6927bf9cc3e0e825a7b4d9b5224738d04090a8ba36c63a4.png] 

Thus, the final series is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0cf264ac788d39840b8da75bfd38c0af72d06e6cee9b261d55440fb634568082.png] 

Hence, "Option 1" is the correct answer.
